bio: William J. Dailey was born in 1851 at Minersville, Schuylkill Co., Pa., a son of Michael Dailey (1839–1869) and Elizabeth Keating (1836–1923). The family was living in Cass Township, Schuylkill County, in 1860 and had moved to Plymouth Township by 1870. He died at Wilkes-Barre on 18 January 1931 and was buried at Larksville.
